title: WRT invariants as radial homological-block limits for negative-definite unimodular six-vertex H-plumbings with leaf weights at most minus two
author: Akihito Mori; Yuya Murakami
work: Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev Invariants, Homological Blocks, and Quantum Modular Forms for Unimodular Plumbing H-Graphs
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof resolves incomplete surgery Gauss sums by deriving weighted cancellations for the two-variable plumbing quadratic form. It matches a two-variable Euler-Maclaurin radial expansion to finite Bernoulli-weighted sums, then explicitly transforms the Kirby-color surgery expression through reciprocity. The new vanishing identities supply precisely the missing lattice terms, making the radial-limit formula rigorous beyond formal q-series or cited Seifert formulas.

source_check.note: The complete author Theorem1.1 route is supplied: weighted Gauss Proposition4.2 with all local arithmetic proofs, Euler-Maclaurin Lemma5.2/Proposition5.3, the surgery formula6.1 and completion identities6.2–6.5. Select the negative-definite determinant-one six-vertex H linking matrix with all weights negative and leaf weights w3–w6<=-2, at integer levels k>=3 so the displayed normalization denominator is nonzero. These explicit restrictions exclude the separately known Seifert/degenerate-normalization edge cases. The exact principal-value homological block and standard S3-normalized WRT convention are retained. Existing surgery formula(6.1), Gauss reciprocity and two-variable Euler-Maclaurin are background; the author proves the new weighted cancellations and lattice completion. The general standalone auxiliary statements4.2/4.4 are not counted; their actual application is only on the nonzero support of the plumbing weight epsilon. Later quantum modularity is a consequence of a prior theorem and is not selected. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.
